description: HydroPowerSimulations.jl extends Sienna's PowerSimulations.jl with hydropower formulations for operational power-system studies. The National Laboratory of the Rockies team publishes the Julia source, stable documentation, tutorials and a model library. Its formulations cover run-of-river dispatch and commitment, reservoir energy or water accounting, and hydro turbines under different operating constraints. Users supply a power-system case, hydro unit limits, inflow or energy budgets, and network and service settings; outputs are scheduled hydro generation, water or energy states, and related dispatch quantities for the chosen time steps. Geography follows the modelled network and the study horizon follows its time series. BSD-3-Clause source is public. A limitation is that this is an extension of the Sienna operations package and requires compatible Sienna data and formulations; it is not a standalone hydrology model. It supports coordinated reservoir and electricity dispatch. The catalogue's platform-sienna covers the parent suite but does not explicitly name this hydropower extension. No operation study was run.
